name: Reference girl · articulated fingers & physics v4

layers.name: Cropped navy jacket · zipper and collar
Coral floral wrap skirt · weighted drape

metadata.description: Front artwork redrawn in the original image coordinates. Other angles are inferred from the single front reference. Thin anime outlines, swept-back black hair, amber sunglasses, cropped navy jacket, exposed waist, floral coral wrap and red heels.
metadata.rigFeatures: 48 bones including 28 finger/thumb joints, ten separately skinned digits, wrist/elbow seam masks, chest springs, pinned waist cloth, eight turn views.
metadata.handUsage: Rig & animate → Hands & fingers: choose a hand and digit, adjust Curl or joint angles. Reference / Open / Grip / Point presets edit native bones. Finger articulation clip demonstrates the poses.
metadata.physicsUsage: Play Secondary motion to see body-driven chest settling and skirt motion. Dynamics & physics exposes Jiggle controls and cloth pins, pose follow, travel and wind. Angle review is a separate clip.
